author: Arnav
problem: Read a word S of uppercase and lowercase letters with odd length. If it has more uppercase letters than lowercase ones, print S in all uppercase; otherwise print it in all lowercase.
bug_description: Decides by whether the uppercase count is odd instead of whether uppercase letters outnumber lowercase ones.

comments.accurate: Counts the uppercase letters and converts the whole word to whichever case is in the majority
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts the uppercase letters and converts the word to uppercase when that count is odd
comments.wrong_location: Case decision verified; check isupper() counts only letters
